meta.title: Models — Take 3 Agency
meta.description: Faces for campaigns, character and camera — cast from a working roster, not a lookbook. Take 3 Agency supplies commercial and campaign models, real-people and character faces, fitting models and promotional talent for brands, film and television.

items.title: Commercial & campaign
items.body: Campaign, stills and moving image — models who take direction and hold up across a full shoot day.

items.title: Real people & character faces
items.body: Faces with something behind them — real-people casting for productions and brands that want believable, not polished.

items.title: Fitting models
items.body: Measured, consistent and reliable — sample sizes and specific measurements for costume and fashion fittings.

items.title: Promotional & event
items.body: Launches, activations and front-of-house — presentable, personable people who represent a brand in the room.

brands.heading: Campaigns, stills, product and lifestyle.
brands.pullQuote: “The difference between a model and the right model is a shoot day that runs on schedule.”
brands.paragraph: Our models come from working sets — comfortable with direction, continuity and long days. Send the brief and the boards; we shortlist from measured, photographed artists with current availability, for stills, moving image, product and lifestyle.

film.heading: Character faces and real-people casting.
film.paragraph: When a production needs a face — a juror who reads lived-in, a featured role with no lines, a period look that holds in close-up — model-polished doesn't cut it. We cast character faces and real people from the same roster that supplies our SAs and doubles, so they already know how a set works.

definitions.description: Faces that carry a frame without a line of dialogue.
Looks cast to era, region and world — checked against your references.
Believable, unpolished faces for documentary-style and testimonial work.

cards.title: Set-experienced

cards.title: Measured & current

cards.title: Admin handled
cards.body: Contracts, usage, fees and coordination through one point of contact — one roster, every format.
